name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A curated set of real-world engineering habits for AI coding agents, shared free by a popular TypeScript educator with 60,000 newsletter readers.
buyer: A developer following the author's newsletter who wants battle-tested AI workflows instead of generic defaults.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs the plugin to get senior-level engineering habits without building their own skill set.
The author monetizes the audience this drives into paid courses and consulting.
A team lead points junior engineers at it as the 'house style' for using AI coding tools.

money_ideas.idea: Use it as a funnel into the author's existing paid newsletter and course offerings.
Offer paid 1:1 or small-group coaching on customizing the skills for a specific company's stack.

steal_this: This weekend, if you run a dev newsletter, publish your own curated skills repo as free marketing that funnels into a paid course, following this exact playbook.
